color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
INTAKE: assembled section block + leaves[] + hints (per candidate)
rule: §Extraction unit — one record per flagged section
exec: L1 · status: BUILT

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
UPSTREAM GATE: a section with NO cue anywhere is never surfaced
rule: Stage-1 recall gate (word_list union = the ceiling)
exec: L1 · status: OPEN (silent FN risk; only control is recall audit vs ground truth)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ORPHAN TRIAGE LANE: orphan / context_quality=partial candidates (n_leaves=0)
rule: RATIFIED — LLM first-pass CLEARS clearly-non-operative (records typed §4 exclusion, → gaps G2);
verdict ASYMMETRIC (clear only the clearly-non-operative, escalate the rest); triage does NOT label burdens
escalated → enriched with retrievable surrounding raw text → RE-ENTER standard path (N5..N10),
normal dual-model + review; orphan=true carried to the final record (same shape; auditable slice)
exec: UNBUILT (lane) · status: DECIDED-UNBUILT (rule ratified, lane unbuilt) · → gaps G25

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EXCLUDED · exclusion_family=non_operative
subclass ∈ {deeming, definitional, machinery_procedural, powers_to_make_secondary,
scheme_machinery, list_of_contents, mixed_other} (recorded best-effort)
exec: UNBUILT (exclusion writer) · status: DECIDED-UNBUILT (typed-exclusion schema ratified, → gaps G2)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N5 DECOMPOSE into burden UNITS
rule: §1 unit rule — obligation-leaf = count each; condition/factor-leaf = count once; span-merge across candidates
exec: UNALLOCATED — THE Layer-3 architecture question (per-candidate / counting-head / BIO-tag / decompose-then-classify)
status: OPEN (burden-vs-condition discriminator not empirically tested — §7 item 3)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N1 OPERATIVE? binds an obligation/prohibition (not deem/define/enable)
rule: §4 non-operative exclusion list — SETTLED (survived three reviews untouched)
exec: UNALLOCATED (L2 deterministic vs L3 LLM split — allocation question, → gaps G1)
status: DECIDED-UNBUILT (rule decided, executor unbuilt)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N2 Operative content is a TEXTUAL AMENDMENT of another instrument?
rule: notes item 4 (amendment = machinery; count at consolidated target) — RATIFIED
exec: UNBUILT (markup-L4? LLM-L3?); is_amendment_insertion BROKEN (0/1,084 — see decision log)
detect at Addition-fragment grain; fix or rename before Stage 2
status: DECIDED-UNBUILT (rule decided, executor unbuilt)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EXCLUDED · exclusion_family=counted_at_source, subclass=amendment_machinery — burden counted at target (residence)
exec: UNBUILT (exclusion writer) · status: DECIDED-UNBUILT (typed-exclusion schema ratified, → gaps G2)
residual OPEN: dedup vs target + editorial-backlog zero-count tail (→ gaps G4/G18)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N3 POINTER / HOOK / CROSS-REFERENCE only? (burden defined elsewhere)
rule: §3 count-at-source family — SETTLED (cross-refs, compliance/contravention hooks, enabling powers,
penalty-as-consequence, offence primary-vs-secondary; several ratified this month)
exec: UNALLOCATED (L2 pattern vs L3 model + referenced-provision resolution — allocation question, → gaps G5)
status: DECIDED-UNBUILT (rule decided, executor unbuilt)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EXCLUDED · exclusion_family=counted_at_source
subclass ∈ {cross_reference, compliance_hook, enabling_power, penalty_as_consequence,
secondary_offence_reference, mixed_other} (recorded best-effort)
exec: UNBUILT · status: DECIDED-UNBUILT (schema ratified → gaps G2; cross-ref resolver → gaps G5)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N4 Burden falls on a PRIVATE ACTOR?
rule: §1/§5C statutory-source function test (statutory=public / contractual=private; funding-irrelevant)
exec: UNALLOCATED — needs a statutory-bodies REGISTRY (does not exist); keyword lists exist but UNWIRED
status: OPEN

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EXCLUDED · exclusion_family=public_body_or_no_one
(levy duties on private firms still COUNT)
exec: UNBUILT (exclusion writer) · status: DECIDED-UNBUILT (typed-exclusion schema ratified, → gaps G2)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ROUTE TO REVIEW (Layer 5) — SCHEMA, not queue tooling
review_reason (primary = first route to fire in tree order; optional secondary for compound cases):
model_disagreement / hybrid_actor / ambiguous_leaf / cat6_category / polarity_review / orphan_escalation / context_term
(+ low_confidence, family_link — PRODUCTION phase only); feeds@resolution ∈ {registry, rubric_example, unit_rule_evidence, training_data, definitions}
lanes = sort records by review_reason; gating lanes first (disagreement blocks training_data, hybrid blocks registry, ambiguous_leaf feeds unit-rule test), rest pool
PHASE: dual-model disagreement = training-data-phase signal; production = Legal-BERT confidence-threshold (same schema, different traffic mix)
exec: L5 label store · status: DECIDED-UNBUILT (schema ratified; fields unbuilt pending label store) · → gaps G21
NB set-vs-set burden-matching mechanics stay OPEN — the Layer-3 architecture question (→ gaps G20, allocation agenda)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N6 CATEGORY 1-6
rule: §2 six categories; Cat2-vs-Cat5 trigger-control; DEFENCE-DOMINANCE → IB/IBA (notes item 7); Cat6→review
exec: L3 dual-model (Claude+Gemini) → L5 human on disagreement — TRAINING-DATA phase;
production = Legal-BERT + confidence-thresholded review (low_confidence routes where disagreement did)
status: DESIGN (defence-dominance = new simplification, pilot-contingent)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N7 POLARITY — obligation / prohibition / review
rule: §2A operative-requirement rule + edge cases; defence-revealed polarity = underlying standard (notes item 9)
exec: L3 dual-model cross-checked → L5 human
status: DESIGN (review-threshold discipline §7 item 9 not operationalised)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N8 OBLIGATED PARTY — actual burdened party, not grammatical subject
rule: §5B re-attribution; schema field obligated_party
exec: L3/L4
status: DESIGN (no controlled party vocabulary → capacity + dedup unstable)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N9 ACTOR CAPACITY — economic / personal / both-either / ambiguous
rule: §1 + notes item 8 — classify the ACTIVITY not the subject; scheme-splits→follow-scheme;
both/either needs POSITIVE 'binds identically either way'; else ambiguous (generous default)
exec: UNALLOCATED — phase-1 generous default; boundary resolution deferred to phase 2/3
status: OPEN (deferred; activity-profile rule new/untested; both/either reporting-line needs schema)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N10 PROVENANCE — introduced_by / introduced_year (nullable)
rule: notes item 5 — residence (count) vs provenance (growth) split
exec: UNALLOCATED — L4 Citation resolver (Addition→Commentary→Citation, ~100% recoverable) NOT built
status: OPEN (fragment-grain, not is_amendment_insertion; multi-instrument sections)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EMIT BURDEN {category, polarity, obligated_party, actor_capacity, provenance, orphan?, family_id?}
exec: L5 label store · status: OPEN (label store / version-control not built)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
COUNTING SPINE: burden-count per candidate + grouping across candidates
PRIMARY count = RESIDENCE-BASED: parallel duties in N jurisdictional instruments = N burdens (NO similarity test on the spine) — → gaps G18
duplicate-family relation = SEPARATE enrichment lens (nullable family_id; uniform/divergent flag), post-labelling / pre-publication
+ body↔schedule join (none, → gaps G19)
→ headline total + economic FLOOR (economic-only; both/either own line)
status: OPEN (spine impl + join unbuilt; devolution-dedup lens DECIDED-UNBUILT → G18)
